series_title: Bách Lâm: Lần Hồi Quy Thứ Một Triệu
origin: Lâm Kim Bách / Bách Lâm / Optimizer
reader_disclaimer: Story information may be fictional, reality-derived, mistaken memory, possible-world content, or UNKNOWN. Interpretation remains the reader's responsibility.

counters.law: R increments for every regression. G increments only for an irreducible new Grand-Ending structure. Repetition can still change compression weight without increasing G.

hard_locks.selection_reason: extreme will to bear knowledge and continue acting under epistemic burden
hard_locks.biological_baseline: exceptional inherited physiology and genotype, near-super-soldier potential within the fiction world, but still finite and increasingly burdened by the seed
hard_locks.compressed_seed: preserves useful causal and generative structure, not all information
hard_locks.recompression_law: Even repeated or low-delta lives are recompressed; recurrence evidence and failure traces increase density and carrier burden without necessarily increasing G.
hard_locks.unlock_dependency: evidence-grounded faith in humanity, cooperation, feasibility, science and resource support

mutation_leakage.effect: energy and partial knowledge can leak beyond the carrier, increasing salience, attraction and independent resonance in other people

hard_locks.energy_balance: E_seed_next = E_seed + PositiveCooperationGain + FeasibilityGain + TrustedResourceGain - LeakLoss - DecompressionCost - CarrierStabilizationCost
hard_locks.extinction_condition: If seed energy falls below the extinction threshold, further regression becomes unavailable.
hard_locks.age_30_partial_awakening: Around age 30 in regression 1,000,000, Bách Lâm reaches Partial Mission Recognition after a long developmental struggle. This is not full awakening.
hard_locks.global_resonance_wave: Around the same period, leakage can raise the probability of independent breakthroughs and resonant research directions worldwide without controlling other people's agency.
premature_life_failures: psychiatric institutionalization within the fiction plot

vietnam_worldbuild.historical_motif: repeated struggle, war, survival, reconstruction and strong self-determination
vietnam_worldbuild.benefit: high will resistance and potentially very strong autonomous nodes
vietnam_worldbuild.cost: strong ego and pride can become coordination friction or a crab-bucket failure pattern if strong nodes pull one another down instead of composing capability

hard_locks.humanity_profile: small and constrained, but resilient, defiant, cooperation-capable, science-building and open-potential
hard_locks.human_agi_relation: not destined enemies; zero-sum competition is a failure mode, not a cosmic law
hard_locks.science_tree_current_timeline: multiple scientific and technological branches mature unusually early and near-synchronously, making previously unbuildable structures barely buildable if coordination succeeds
hard_locks.cosmic_death: the universe may die without mandatory contraction or automatic Big Bang reset
hard_locks.time_ontology: OPEN_UNKNOWN; at least two opposed time-like regimes are possible, names and mechanisms not yet canonical

negative_unlock_signals: strong nodes suppressing other strong nodes
positive_unlock_signals: science that predicts, intervenes and self-corrects

hard_locked_relations: seed-energy dependence on cooperation and feasibility
life begins from childhood rather than full-memory omniscience
